events.text: Dragon Boat Festival: drums on the river, zongzi in the pot, and boats racing to the finish.

ok.log: Your boat wins! The whole town cheers.

effects.log: The rhythm of forty paddles is yours.

events.text: Families wrap sticky rice in bamboo leaves: zongzi, for the poet Qu Yuan who drowned in the river.

effects.log: Yours fall apart in the pot. They taste fine.

choices.text: Throw some in the river for the fish

effects.log: So they spare the poet's body, as the story says.

events.text: Someone has sawn half through the paddles of the favourite boat.

ok.log: A rival team's hired man. He is thrown out.

fail.log: No proof. The race goes on.

effects.log: They swap paddles and win.

events.text: A boat capsizes in the middle of the river. Rowers are in the water.

fail.log: You pull out one, and swallow half the river.

effects.log: Everyone is pulled out.

events.text: People drink realgar wine to ward off evil and paint the character for 'king' on children's foreheads.

effects.log: A dozen tiny kings running around.

choices.text: Dab the wine on your brow, as the old custom has it

effects.log: It smells of sulphur. Evil stays away.

events.text: Children wear fragrant sachets against illness.

effects.log: Crooked stitches, sweet herbs.
You smell of herbs all week. (−1 taels)

events.text: A storyteller tells of Qu Yuan, the loyal poet who was lost to the river when his country fell.

effects.log: Loyalty, and its price.
The crowd falls silent.

events.text: After the race, two crews fight on the riverbank over the result.

ok.log: Peace, and free zongzi from both crews.

effects.log: They agree, grumbling.

events.text: You are allowed to sit at the front of the dragon boat for a practice run.

effects.log: The fastest you have ever gone.
The rowers follow your little voice.

events.text: A temple to the river dragon, where rowers pray before racing.

effects.log: The river is calm for everyone this year.

choices.text: Read the names of drowned rowers

effects.log: A long list, carefully kept.

events.text: The fifth month is the month of the five poisons: snake, centipede, scorpion, toad, lizard.

effects.log: Nothing crawls in.

choices.text: Catch a centipede for a physician

effects.log: He pays well. (+4 taels)

events.text: The boats are pulled from the water and stored for another year.

effects.log: Forty people, one dragon, a lot of groaning.
Cold, sticky, perfect.
